answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit delivery bond on a key-signed ember crate at the jetty ledger. The crate must cross the bridge for stamps at three checkpoints before the epoch closes. At the jetty an auditor weighs it against the public table; a missing stamp, wrong weight, or reused serial burns the bond. First haul 34, k-th 34+6(k-1): a rented-haul ring of 1,000 fakes pays 3,031,000 for at most 40,000 in rewards. Honest agents pay 34 once.
